items.title: Konitz Lee — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Same thing I did with Mingus. He wrote out a solo for me... Then many years later with the big band... he brought out that arrangement and everybody looked and Mingus said 'follow Konitz'.

ctx.x: He treated you well even if he wasn’t a big fan of your music.

Right. That Ralph Burns date I think I was with Atlantic at that time. [He] said that . . . I’m not supposed to play any solos. Norman said “That’s okay”. He wanted me to play some solos on that record and I did. Same thing I did with Mingus. He wrote out a solo for me.

items.title: 67802_Charles Mingus oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Yeah, Lee Konitz and Mulligan and everybody. Ammons [INTERVIEWEE] Gene Hammonds?

ctx.x: The one with the big band, the one at Philharmonic Hall.
